_read_me: These are the GOAL numbers (in degrees) that Angle Coach compares you with.
Each check has a 'min' and a 'max'. If your number is in between, you get full points.
kneeBend = the angle at your knee on your bent (gliding) leg. 180 is a straight leg, 90 is a deep squat. SMALLER means MORE bend.
forwardLean = how far your shoulders tip forward from standing straight up. 0 is standing tall. BIGGER means MORE lean.
strideExtension = the angle at your knee on your pushing leg when your feet are farthest apart. 180 is a fully straight push.
To change a goal, change the number, keep the commas and quotes, and save. See README.md, section 'Tuning the targets'.
